question: Why is the full hierarchical teaching presented if the highest reality transcends fruit-seeking?
premises: Because of the freedom of consciousness's own nature, some still desire fruits.
Aiming at those seekers, the teaching presents the whole system.
The presentation extends from earth up to Śiva for their fulfillment.
inference: The graded scriptural system is taught out of consciousness's freedom to accommodate those who still seek fruits.
plain_english: Because consciousness is free by its very nature, some people still desire fruits. For their sake, the entire teaching is set forth, from earth up to Śiva, so that their aims may be fulfilled.
